exceptions.reason: Orchestrator-delegated seven-day acceptance: Firebase 12 Firestore pins the affected Node gRPC transport to ~1.9.0, but this Astro site builds static output without a server adapter; Firestore browser exports and built client assets do not include grpc-js. The malformed compressed gRPC message prerequisite is absent from this deployed browser path. Reassess on SSR, adapter, bundle, or SDK changes; do not override the upstream pin or downgrade Firebase without separate compatibility review.
